title: acme-pipeline: platform month
subtitle: The platform month chain on acme-pipeline: each step's page, what it found, what is still open, and whether the chain is done.

verdict.text: October closes with one table missing its freshness target and EUR 210 a month spent on tables nobody reads. Both wait on a decision by the owners named on the page.

sections.title: The chain
sections.intro: Every step ran today; none was reused from an earlier day.
